tieu_de: Senior/ Lead PHP developer Symfony, English
dia_chi_raw: The Emporium, 3rd Floor, 184 Le Dai Hanh
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Job description
Design, test, and maintain robust PHP applications that meet business and technical requirements.
Produce clean and maintainable code while adhering to coding standards, security best practices, and software engineering principles.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design scalable architectures and integration solutions.
Implement automated testing, code quality controls, and CI/CD practices to ensure reliable software delivery.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to application performance, system integrations, databases, and production environments.
Optimize application performance through caching, database tuning, and system monitoring.
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture decisions to continuously improve product quality.
Research, evaluate, and adopt new technologies and best practices to enhance development processes and technical capabilities.
Mentor and support team members in solution design and coding issues; and evaluate their performance.
yeu_cau:
Desired Skills and Experience
5+ years’ experience in PHP 8.x development (ideally 8.4/8.5) and OOP, applying modern architecture concepts (dependency injection, service containers, event-driven design, modular components, and middleware pipelines).
Proficient in Symfony (5.4 up to 7.4) to build scalable and high-performance applications.
Hands-on experience with testing and code quality tools: PHPUnit, PHPStan, PHP CS Fixer, and Sonar.
Solid understanding of web technologies and HTTP protocols, including CORS, HTTP headers, authentication, authorization, API communication standards, and web application security best practices.
Comfortable working on macOS/Linux with shell and CLI tools.
Experience developing RESTful APIs, microservices, and API-first solutions in distributed environments.
Strong skills in performance optimization and caching strategies (Redis, HTTP caching); experience with Varnish, Nginx, or PHP-FPM is a plus.
Understanding of application architecture, design patterns, and best practices (clean code, SOLID; DDD and CQRS are a plus).
Experience with relational databases (MariaDB/MariastgreSQL), including database management, query optimization, schema design, and data import/export.
Experience working with Docker, FrankenPHP, MariaDB, Redis, and AWS services.
Familiar with Jira, Confluence, GitHub and CI/CD workflows.
Good communication in English, written and spoken.
Demonstrated leadership, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically while staying hands-on.
Nice-to-have skills:
Exposure to MuleSoft integration platform.
